name: Award For Meritorious Students Of Meghalaya In The HSSLC Examination (Science Stream)
benefit: > The award of ₹10,000/- per awardee along with a certificate.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a tribal student belonging to the Khasi, Jaintia, Garo, Koch, or Hajong tribes of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant should have passed the current HSSLC Examination from the Science stream. 1. The applicant should have secured 60% or above aggregate marks in the examination.
